title: Check arguments in calls.
summary: Mypy expects that the number and names of arguments match the called function. Note that argument type checks have a separate error code arg-type. mypy enables this error code by default.

title: Check calls to overloaded functions.
summary: When you call an overloaded function, mypy checks that at least one of the signatures of the overload items match the argument types in the call. mypy enables this error code by default.
